sections.title: DATA PROTECTION AND CONSENT
sections.intro: Care Net Consultants (Pty) Ltd processes the information in this questionnaire for the sole specified purpose of designing your organisation's medical surveillance programme, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting the Care Net Information Officer. This form must not contain any employee's identity number, medical condition, or other personal information about an identifiable individual.

I understand that Care Net Consultants (Pty) Ltd will design the organisation's Medical Surveillance Plan based on this information and any risk assessment or hygiene monitoring documents attached, and that Care Net does not independently conduct the underlying workplace risk assessment as part of this process.
